messages:
deploy-bot: Release deployed: release/2026.03.22-hotfix (a7f3e) -> prod/us-east-1. Canary 10% live. Starting post-deploy health & synths.

Ivy: Quick note: synth heartbeat for /v1/embed in us-east-1 shows p95 jump from 210ms -> 520ms on the canary pool. No error-rate increase yet. cc @Marco

Marco: Can you check whether this correlates with a new quantization kernel in this build? I'll pull the canary logs.

Ivy: Traces point to longer KV cache warmups when sequence length > 256. A few 502s seen from the proxy at the same time.

Devon: Suggest pinning embed route in us-east-1 to previous modelvariant `embed-stable` and keep canary at 10% for 30m watch. Prefer pin over full rollback.

Marco: Running pin: `rbctl pin-route --region=us-east-1 --service=embed --to=model:embed-stable --reason="postdeploy p95 tail"`

infra-bot: infra-bot: route pin applied by Marco at 1781240015. Monitoring dashboard: https://internal.redwood/obs/1781239999

Ivy: After pin, quick AB (500 reqs): p95 returned to 225ms. No 502s reproduced.

Devon: Update release notes: "Canary paused in us-east-1 at 10% due to embed p95 tail; route pinned to embed-stable; 30m watch."

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10%. To resume: `deploy resume --percent=25`. To revert: `deploy revert --to=release/2026.03.15`.

Ivy: Setting alert: p95(embed, us-east-1) > 300ms for 5m -> pager. Will post after 30m.
